title: Money you may be missing this year

programs.name: CalFresh
programs.line: Apply for CalFresh on BenefitsCal today. The steps are at the top of this card.
notes: 12 times the monthly estimate, if nothing changes. The first month is paid from the day you apply, so the total may be lower.
programs.source_text: Source: CalFresh FY2027 table (CDSS ACIN I-40-26), Sep 10, 2026

programs.name: Medi-Cal
programs.line: Health coverage for doctor, hospital and prescriptions, at no cost for most students today. Check the health box on the same BenefitsCal application.
notes: Same application as CalFresh. No second form.

prefill.question: Do you also want health coverage (Medi-Cal)?
Will someone claim you as a tax dependent?
How much do you earn from work each month?

programs.source_text: Source: DHCS letter ACWDL 26-01 (2026 income limits), Jan 21, 2026

programs.name: Clipper START
programs.line: Half-price Muni, BART and buses over winter and summer break: about $160 a year. Your Gator Pass already covers the semesters.
notes: Use your OneCard in semesters and the Clipper START card on breaks.
With CalFresh you can choose "Verify instantly through CalFresh". The card comes by mail, usually within 30 days.
programs.stage_label: When your CalFresh approval letter comes

prefill.question: Which photo ID will you upload?
prefill.answer: A photo ID that shows your date of birth (the form lists which kinds count)

prefill.question: Where should the card be mailed?
prefill.answer: Any address where you can get mail

programs.source_text: Source: Clipper START FAQ, checked Oct 1, 2026

programs.name: California LifeLine
programs.line: Phone discount: up to $220 a year with California LifeLine ($19 a month at most; less if your plan costs less).
notes: Federal Lifeline may add up to $110 a year more.
If your family pays your phone plan, the saving is theirs.
CalFresh or Medi-Cal counts as proof. Pick one LifeLine phone company and apply through it.
programs.stage_label: When your CalFresh approval letter comes

prefill.question: Which program do you get?
prefill.answer: CalFresh or Medi-Cal (after your approval letter comes)

prefill.question: Do you share money with other adults where you live?
prefill.answer: No, my roommates and I don't share money

prefill.question: Which service is the discount for?

programs.source_text: Source: CPUC: California LifeLine and federal Lifeline, Feb 18, 2026

programs.name: PG&E CARE
programs.line: PG&E discount: about $170 a year as your share (about $510 for the home). Assumed bill: $140 a month split 3 ways; yours may differ.
notes: Your roommate on the bill applies and ticks the CalFresh box once you get CalFresh. They can't be someone's tax dependent.
CalFresh opens it: tick the CalFresh box. No income papers needed to apply.
programs.stage_label: When your CalFresh approval letter comes

prefill.question: Section 2A: which program does someone in your home get?
How many people live in your home?
Whose name is on the PG&E bill?

programs.source_text: Source: CPUC: CARE and FERA programs, checked Oct 1, 2026

programs.name: Tax credits (CalEITC, EITC)
programs.line: Maybe about $200 in tax credits at tax time. A free tax volunteer at SF State VITA checks whether you can claim it.
notes: The state credit works with an SSN or ITIN. The federal credit needs an SSN valid for work.
Haven't filed for 2025? You may still file and claim credits for free.
Tax credits like the EITC don't lower your CalFresh.
Based on the 2025 state tables (2026 not out yet) and your monthly pay all year. A credit amount, not your refund.
programs.stage_label: At tax time (usually late January to April 15)

prefill.question: How much did you earn from work in 2026? Bring your W-2.
Did you live with a parent? Time away at school can count.
prefill.answer: Tell the volunteer. It decides who can claim the credit.

programs.source_text: Source: FTB 3514 instructions and table, tax year 2025, 2025

share_text: I found about $4,200 a year in aid I may be missing (estimates, not promises). Check yours in 2 minutes: https://gatorplate.fly.dev
footnote: Estimates for the next 12 months from official rules, checked Oct 1, 2026. Each agency decides. Not a promise.

labels.ui.calfresh_part: CalFresh: about $3,670 a year ($306 a month)
labels.ui.key_line: CalFresh is the key. It opens the others.
labels.ui.list_only_intro: These may help you too. A person checks them with you, so no amounts yet.
